UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Griffin。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Griffin when used on the road.

Description.SourceString: Griffin，雷加利亚旗下工艺与科技的结晶，配置最新的驾驶辅助系统和智能信息娱乐系统，流线型车身与标志性跳灯的完美融合，彰显了雷加利亚对于细节的极致追求。
Description.LocalizedString: Griffin, a masterpiece of craftsmanship and technology from Regalia, is equipped with the latest driver assistance system and intelligent infotainment system. The sleek body and signature pop-up headlights perfectly reflect Regalia's pursuit of excellence in detail.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆G3。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons G3 when used on the road.

Description.SourceString: G3，无可比拟的硬朗外形，搭配最先进的四轮驱动系统和豪华内饰，无论是商务还是休闲场合，让您在任何环境都从容自信。
Description.LocalizedString: G3, with its unmatched robust look, paired with the most advanced four-wheel drive system and luxurious interior, ensures your confidence and poise in any setting, whether it's for business or leisure.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Griffin Volante。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Griffin Volante.

Description.SourceString: 雷加利亚最新敞篷汽车，无可比拟的流线外形，将空气动力学与美学推至极致，敞篷设计让都市喧嚣也成为最自由的风。
Description.LocalizedString: Regalia's latest convertible, with unmatched streamlined styling that pushes aerodynamics and aesthetics to their limits. The convertible design transforms even the urban bustle into the most liberating breeze.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆B100。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon B100.

Description.SourceString: 新越新品B100，轻量化车身和低重心布局，让你感受稳健而灵敏的驾驶回应。
Description.LocalizedString: The new Novus B100, featuring lightweight construction and low center of gravity, delivers stable yet responsive driving feedback.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆C2000。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons C2000 when used on the road.

Description.SourceString: 新越-C2000，经济适用与卓越性能的完美结合，宽敞舒适的驾乘体验，高效运转的动力系统，让每一次出行，都安稳可靠。
Description.LocalizedString: Novus C2000, a perfect blend of economy and exceptional performance. With its spacious and comfortable ride and efficient power system, every journey is stable and reliable.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆M1000。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon M1000.

Description.SourceString: 新越M1000，紧凑车身设计，极致灵活操纵体验，让你在城市拥堵中也游刃有余。
Description.LocalizedString: Novus M1000 features a compact body design with exceptional agile handling, letting you navigate through city traffic with ease.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Novis ST-X 950。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Novis ST-X 950.

Description.SourceString: 雷加利亚的得意之作，传承超跑血统，搭配高性能发动机，每次加速都是对极限发起挑战。
Description.LocalizedString: Regalia's masterpiece. Supercar DNA with high-performance engine. Every acceleration is a push to the limits.

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆Rover A1。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Rover A1.

Description.SourceString: Rover A1，轻巧车身，节能环保，短途通勤的最佳伴侣。
Description.LocalizedString: Rover A1, with its lightweight body, energy-efficient and eco-friendly design, is the perfect companion for short commutes.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆LaVelox。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon LaVelox.

Description.SourceString: LaVelox，搭载混合动力系统，结合尖端引擎和最新科技材料，重新定义，什么是超跑。
Description.LocalizedString: LaVelox, equipped with a hybrid power system, combining cutting-edge engines and the latest technological materials, redefining what it means to be a supercar.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Pursuit V8。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Pursuit V8.

Description.SourceString: Pursuit V8，精准调校的四驱系统，启动时的低沉轰鸣声浪，感受纯粹机械魅力。
Description.LocalizedString: Pursuit V8, with its precisely tuned all-wheel drive system and deep rumbling sound upon startup, you'll experience the pure appeal of mechanical engineering.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆ST79。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon ST79.

Description.SourceString: ST79，简洁实用的机械结构，复古外形搭配充满机械感的手动变速箱，纯粹的驾驶乐趣，就此启程。
Description.LocalizedString: ST79, featuring a simple and practical mechanical structure, and a retro appearance paired with a mechanical manual transmission full of character. Pure driving pleasure begins here.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Enforcer。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Enforcer.

Description.SourceString: Enforcer，充满力量感的车身线条配合以强劲马力，坚固耐用，助你成为道路的掌控者。
Description.LocalizedString: Enforcer. Bold body lines and raw horsepower combine in a tough, reliable design built to help you dominate the road.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Pendragon。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Pendragon.

Description.SourceString: Pendragon，雷加利亚对未来探索的最新力作，用科技缔造新的超跑传奇。
Description.LocalizedString: Pendragon. Regalia's latest masterpiece for future exploration, forging new supercar legends with cutting-edge technology.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Porsche 918 Spyder。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Porsche 918 Spyder.

Description.SourceString: Porsche 918 Spyder，超凡脱俗的未来感外形，无与伦比的驾驶动态，助力您的非凡人生。
Description.LocalizedString: Porsche 918 Spyder - sculpted for the future, engineered to perform. Built for those who never settle for ordinary.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Blizzard-V4。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Blizzard-V4.

Description.SourceString: 雷加利亚新款摩托，拥有独特的空气动力学外形与高性能动力系统，专为职业赛车手打造。
Description.LocalizedString: Regalia's new motorcycle features a unique aerodynamic design and a high-performance power system, crafted specifically for professional racers.

UseContext.LocalizedString: Summons Griffin when used on the road. Since it belongs to someone else, the Security Office will lock and impound it after one use.

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆K01。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon K01.

Description.SourceString: 休闲型卡丁车，操纵灵活，强劲的引擎搭载氮气加速系统，让你充分感受到速度的乐趣！
Description.LocalizedString: A hobbyist go-kart with superb handling and a powerful engine fitted with a nitrous acceleration system—put pedal to the metal and feel the wind on your face!

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆Rover A1。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Rover A1.

Description.SourceString: Rover A1，轻巧车身，节能环保，短途通勤的最佳伴侣。
Description.LocalizedString: Rover A1, with its lightweight body, energy-efficient and eco-friendly design, is the perfect companion for short commutes.

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆「冲向明天！」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Tomorrow Rush.

Description.SourceString: 由「管家」大卫先生驱动的次世代新概念载具。在下次迭代中，我们预计将其改为燃料驱动，使用大小相等的四轮，以及更安全的封闭轿厢。这是载具界的一次重大突破！
Description.LocalizedString: Next-gen concept vehicle driven by Mr. David, the Butler. Future models will use fuel, four equal wheels, and a safer enclosed cabin—a major leap in vehicle design!

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆Rover A1。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Rover A1.

Description.SourceString: Rover A1，轻巧车身，节能环保，短途通勤的最佳伴侣。
Description.LocalizedString: Rover A1, with its lightweight body, energy-efficient and eco-friendly design, is the perfect companion for short commutes.

UseContext.SourceString: 可根据所处位置自由选择驾驶的车辆。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Freely select a vehicle to drive based on your current location.

Description.SourceString: 便捷出行，一把钥匙就够了！
Description.LocalizedString: Travel made easy. One key is all you need!

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Draco。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Draco.

Description.SourceString: 颠覆想象的设计，突破道路的局限。若穿着特定装备驾驶，则会变化为更具幻想色彩的特殊形态。
Description.LocalizedString: A design that defies imagination and leaves the limits of the road behind. With the right gear equipped, it transforms into an even more fantastical form.

UseContext.SourceString: 在海洋或湖泊区域使用后呼叫船只Tide。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use near the ocean or a lake to summon Tide.

Description.SourceString: Hikari's成名之作，独特外观、强劲动力，助你掌控浪潮。
Description.LocalizedString: Hikari's signature creation. Its distinctive design and powerful performance put you in command of the tides and waves.

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆「旧时光」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Yesteryear.

Description.SourceString: Landric匠心打造，采用高品质金属与皮革，车身轻巧灵活，助你自在漫游都市。
Description.LocalizedString: Meticulously crafted by Landric with premium metal and leather, its lightweight, agile frame lets you roam the city with ease.

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆「热风」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Sirocco.

Description.SourceString: 广阔的海岸线，是你的全新越野场。驾驶它，征服沙浪！
Description.LocalizedString: The vast coastline is your brand-new off-road playground. Take the wheel and conquer the dunes!

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Porsche 911 Turbo (930)。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Porsche 911 Turbo (930).

Description.SourceString: Porsche 911 Turbo (930)，将整个时代甩进后视镜。
Description.LocalizedString: Porsche 911 Turbo (930). Making tomorrow history.

ItemName.SourceString: Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package
ItemName.LocalizedString: Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package.

Description.SourceString: Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package，用新时代动力重新阐释跑车基因，极致性能助你征服赛道。
Description.LocalizedString: Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package. Powered by Future. Born to conquer.

UseContext.SourceString: 在海洋或湖泊区域使用后呼叫船只「划向明天！」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use near the ocean or a lake to summon Row to Tomorrow!

Description.SourceString: 由「管家」大卫先生驱动的精品小船。在下次迭代中，我们预计将其改为金属材质，加装发动机，以及更安全的封闭船舱。这是船只界的一次重大突破！
Description.LocalizedString: A finely crafted little boat piloted by Mr. David, the Butler. Future models will feature a metal hull, an engine, and a safer enclosed cabin—a major leap in boat design!

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆「坦途」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Iron Ogre.

Description.SourceString: 你所驶过的路，都将变为坦途。
Description.LocalizedString: In this ride, every road leads to Easy Street.

UseContext.SourceString: 在空旷处使用后呼叫车辆「试作型陆地霸者001」。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use in an open area to summon Prototype Land Overlord 001.

Description.SourceString: 「这辆车很气派嘛！但是为什么不会动啊？」「坐过摇摇车没？看到上面的投币口了吗？开起来要钱的嘛！」「什么嘛，要钱的啊！」
Description.LocalizedString: "Whoa, this car looks awesome! So why won't it move?" "Ever tried one of those coin-operated kiddie rides? See that coin slot up there? Same deal. Gotta pay to make it go!" "Wait, I have to PAY to drive this thing?!"

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆A001。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon A001.

Description.SourceString: 新越制造，用于医护救援。
Description.LocalizedString: Made by Novus for medical emergencies.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆E001。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon E001.

Description.SourceString: 新越制造，用于押运囚犯。
Description.LocalizedString: Made by Novus for prisoner transfers.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆C001。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon C001.

Description.SourceString: 新越制造，用于押运各类贵重物品。
Description.LocalizedString: Made by Novus to ensure secure transport of valuable goods.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Ori-LV01。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Ori - LV01.

Description.SourceString: 库霸快送定制车型。坚固货厢，保障运输安全。
Description.LocalizedString: A custom Kool Express vehicle with a sturdy cargo compartment to keep shipments safe.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Ori-LV03。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the road to summon Ori - LV03.

Description.SourceString: 库霸快送定制车型。更大容量的坚固货厢，保障运输安全。
Description.LocalizedString: A custom Kool Express vehicle with a larger, sturdier cargo compartment to keep shipments safe.

UseContext.SourceString: 在路边使用后呼叫车辆Ori-TT01。
UseContext.LocalizedString: Use by the roadside to summon Ori-TT01.

Description.SourceString: 奥利哈刚制造，用于托运车辆、交通事故救援等。
Description.LocalizedString: Made by Orichalcos for vehicle transport, towing, and more.
